[[package]]
name = "bizlog"
version = "0.6.4"
source = { directory = "../../03-shared-services/bizlog" }
dependencies = [
    { name = "colorama" },
    { name = "defusedxml" },
    { name = "pika" },
--
requires-dist = [
    { name = "bandit", marker = "extra == 'dev'", specifier = ">=1.7.0,<2.0.0" },
    { name = "bizlog", extras = ["dev", "test", "docs", "audit", "rabbitmq"], marker = "extra == 'all'" },
    { name = "colorama", specifier = ">=0.4.0,<1.0.0" },
    { name = "coverage", marker = "extra == 'dev'", specifier = ">=7.0.0,<8.0.0" },
    { name = "defusedxml", specifier = ">=0.7.1,<1.0.0" },
    { name = "detect-secrets", marker = "extra == 'dev'", specifier = ">=1.5.0,<2.0.0" },
    { name = "mypy", marker = "extra == 'dev'", specifier = ">=2.0.0,<3.0.0" },
    { name = "pdoc", marker = "extra == 'docs'", specifier = ">=16.0.0,<17.0.0" },
--
====
dependencies = [
    { name = "aiohttp" },
    { name = "demospipes-data-structures" },
    { name = "prefect" },
    { name = "prefect-docker" },
    { name = "prefect-kubernetes" },
    { name = "pydantic" },
    { name = "pydantic-settings" },
]
--
requires-dist = [
    { name = "aiohttp", specifier = "~=3.14.3" },
    { name = "demospipes-data-structures", directory = "../data-structures" },
    { name = "prefect", specifier = "==3.7.4" },

observation.command: cd /workspace && grep -B2 -A6 'name = "bizlog"' 02-backend/dokumentenpruefung/uv.lock | head -20; echo ====; grep -B2 -A6 'name = "demospipes-data-structures"' 02-backend/demospipes/core/uv.lock | head -14
